_notes: COHORT-SPECIFIC TRIAL: criteria differ by cohort (dose escalation vs dose expansion/Phase II). Labeled only criteria common to ALL patients as structured; cohort-specific ones kept in unstructured. EGFR mutation required for everyone -> biomarkers EGFR required_positive. C797S mutation and measurable-disease requirement apply ONLY to dose expansion/Phase II -> unstructured_inclusion, not structured (measurable_disease_required left null because it is not universal; the C797S detail is cohort-specific so not folded into the EGFR requirement). No max age stated -> max_age_years null. Labs: ANC>=1.5, platelets>=100, hemoglobin>=9, total bilirubin<=1.5xULN, ALT<=3xULN, AST<=3xULN, eGFR>=50. Bilirubin/ALT/AST use x ULN and conditional (liver-mets, Gilbert's) variants -> labeled the base threshold, conditional variants noted in unstructured. Removed broken 'section Error! Reference source not found.' cross-reference from source text.
trial_title: BPI-361175 Tablets in Patients With Advanced Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

biomarkers.detail: EGFR mutation; C797S specifically required for dose-expansion/Phase II cohort only

unstructured_inclusion: NSCLC must be inoperable locally advanced or recurrent/metastatic; patient progressed from, intolerant to, or unfit for standard treatment
Dose escalation cohort: documented EGFR mutation progressed on/after third-generation EGFR-TKI
Dose expansion/Phase II cohort: EGFR C797S mutation confirmed on tissue or blood, with radiological progression from first/second/third-generation EGFR-TKIs
Dose expansion/Phase II cohort: at least one measurable lesion per RECIST v1.1
Conditional liver thresholds: if liver metastases, AST/ALT <= 5.0 x ULN; if Gilbert's syndrome, total bilirubin <= 3.0 x ULN
Acute toxic effects of prior therapy/surgery resolved to baseline or <= CTCAE Grade 1 (except alopecia)
Women of childbearing potential: negative serum pregnancy test within 7 days, non-lactating, contraception through treatment + 3 months after last dose
Men with partners of childbearing potential: adequate contraception during study + 90 days after last dose
unstructured_exclusion: Unstable/symptomatic primary CNS tumors, metastases, or leptomeningeal metastases (may enroll if stable, no progression within 2 weeks, off corticosteroid/anticonvulsant/mannitol > 2 weeks before first dose)
Most recent antitumor therapy within 4 weeks or ~5 half-lives (whichever longer) before first dose
Gastrointestinal disorders affecting oral swallowing or drug absorption
Strong or moderate CYP3A inhibitors or inducers within 7 days before first dose
Autologous (within 3 months) or allogeneic (within 6 months) organ/stem cell transplant; major surgery or severe trauma (except biopsy) within 4 months before first dose
Palliative radiation within 2 weeks before first dose
Active viral hepatitis B (exception: HBV DNA <= 500 IU/mL, stable > 4 weeks)
Active infection requiring systemic therapy within 1 week before first dose
Cardiac conditions within last 6 months (presyncope/syncope, tachycardia, ventricular fibrillation, sudden cardiac arrest; QTcF > 450 msec male / > 470 msec female)
Any > CTCAE Grade 1 toxicity before first dose
History of interstitial lung disease, drug-induced ILD, radiation pneumonitis requiring steroids, clinically active ILD, uncontrolled systemic disease, or other serious illness
Deep venous thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, or other serious thromboembolism within 3 months before first dose (port/catheter-related/superficial not counted)
Drug abuse or medical/psychological/social conditions preventing protocol compliance
